title: Analysis of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) removal with activated carbon using 19F nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5716-5725
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06437F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
G. F. Earl, L. A. Stevens, W. Li, C. E. Snape
19 F NMR is used to screen and rank activated carbons for PFAS removal, allowing direct quantification of PFOS, PFOA, PFHxA and PFBS to identify the most effective adsorbent.
